title: Contested loose ball
description: Home builds through midfield, then a loose pass starts a 60-frame scramble. Home and away each get short bursts of clear control before away wins the ball outright.

provenance.statement: Synthetic data, scripted in tools/export_scenarios.py. No competition data was read. Model labels are the unchanged Python engines' output.

events.description: Home #6 plays an under-hit pass; nobody controls it.
Home #10 and away #8 scramble for the ball. Each gets short bursts of clear control; by the script, home keeps possession until away wins it.
Away #8 wins the ball outright and keeps it.

reference.description: Written down from the scenario script, not produced by any model.
